evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat assertive statement of what this does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or operational settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule with modal 'must' stating a non-negotiable requirement the speaker expects others to act on — decision-grade commitment, not merely an argued position.
